WITH s AS (
  SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval,
         (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS stress_score
  FROM system_controller sc
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = sc.systemoverseeractuation
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
), m AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY modelseriesval) AS model_avg_stress FROM s
)
SELECT robot_id, LOWER(modelseriesval) AS model, stress_score, model_avg_stress
FROM m WHERE stress_score > 1.2 * model_avg_stress
ORDER BY stress_score DESC

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, mf.faultpredscore, mf.rulhours / 24.0 AS rul_days
FROM maintenance_and_fault mf
JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = mf.upkeepactuation
WHERE mf.rulhours / 24.0 < 7 AND mf.faultpredscore > 0.7
ORDER BY rul_days ASC, mf.faultpredscore DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG((j.value->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric), 2) AS fleet_avg_vibration_mmps FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) j

WITH t AS (
  SELECT o.operreg, o.operrecref AS robot_id, o.apptypeval,
         60.0 / o.cycletimesecval AS throughput_rate,
         NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY o.apptypeval ORDER BY 60.0 / o.cycletimesecval DESC) AS quintile
  FROM operation o
  WHERE o.cycletimesecval IS NOT NULL AND o.cycletimesecval > 0 AND o.apptypeval IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t.robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
       a.payloadwval / rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_utilization_ratio,
       t.throughput_rate
FROM t
JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actoperref = t.operreg
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = t.robot_id
WHERE t.quintile = 1 AND a.payloadwval / rd.payloadcapkg > 0.8
ORDER BY payload_utilization_ratio DESC, t.throughput_rate DESC
note: The robot ID is included ahead of the requested columns. Quintiles are NTILE(5) over the throughput rate within each non-null application type.

WITH jt AS (
  SELECT jc.jcondoperref AS operreg, jc.jcdetref AS robot_id,
         AVG((j.value->>'temperature_C')::numeric) AS avg_temp,
         MAX((j.value->>'temperature_C')::numeric) AS max_temp,
         MIN((j.value->>'temperature_C')::numeric) AS min_temp
  FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) j
  GROUP BY jc.jcondoperref, jc.jcdetref
), pmu AS (
  SELECT mf.upkeepoperation AS operreg,
         (1000.0 / (mf.rulhours + 1)) + (mf.faultpredscore * 10) AS pmu_score
  FROM maintenance_and_fault mf
)
SELECT jt.robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model, pmu.pmu_score, jt.max_temp
FROM pmu
JOIN jt ON jt.operreg = pmu.operreg
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = jt.robot_id
WHERE pmu.pmu_score > 50
  AND (jt.avg_temp > 75 OR jt.max_temp - jt.min_temp > 15)
ORDER BY pmu.pmu_score DESC, jt.max_temp DESC

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, o.apptypeval AS application_type,
       a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval AS relative_positional_error,
       p.calibstateval AS calibration_state
FROM actuation_data a
JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
JOIN performance_and_safety p ON p.effectivenessactuation = a.actreg
WHERE o.apptypeval IN ('Assembly','Electronics-Handling','Inspection','Dispensing','Laser Cutting')
  AND a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval > 0.0001
ORDER BY relative_positional_error DESC
note: Only 'Assembly' of the Precision-Critical list occurs in the data; calibration state comes from performance_and_safety, which covers about half the operations, so robots without a calibration record are left out (inner join). Raw codes Y/0/N are returned.

WITH h AS (
  SELECT p.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id, LOWER(rd.mfgnameval) AS manufacturer,
         (1.0 - p.conditionindexval) / (CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval) AS hdr
  FROM performance_and_safety p
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = p.effectivenessrobot
  WHERE (CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval) > 0
)
SELECT manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS degrading_robot_count, AVG(hdr) AS avg_health_degradation_rate
FROM h
WHERE hdr > 0
GROUP BY manufacturer
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY degrading_robot_count DESC

WITH s AS (
  SELECT sc.systemoverseeroperation AS operreg, a.actrecref AS robot_id,
         rd.mfgnameval, rd.modelseriesval,
         (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS stress_score,
         AVG((sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.modelseriesval) AS model_avg_stress
  FROM system_controller sc
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = sc.systemoverseeractuation
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
), w AS (
  SELECT jc.jcondoperref AS operreg,
         0.6 * AVG((j.value->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric) + 0.4 * AVG((j.value->>'backlash_deg')::numeric) AS wear_score
  FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) j
  GROUP BY jc.jcondoperref
)
SELECT s.robot_id, s.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, LOWER(s.modelseriesval) AS model,
       s.stress_score, w.wear_score
FROM s JOIN w ON w.operreg = s.operreg
WHERE s.stress_score >= 1.2 * s.model_avg_stress
  AND w.wear_score >= 0.5
ORDER BY s.mfgnameval, s.stress_score DESC

WITH r AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding','Grinding','Deburring','Palletizing','Machine Tending')
              THEN 'High-Wear Applications' ELSE 'Other Applications' END AS application_group,
         CASE WHEN p.emergencystopcount > 0
                   AND o.totopshrval / p.emergencystopcount < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_high_risk
  FROM performance_and_safety p
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = p.effectivenessactuation
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
)
SELECT application_group, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_high_risk) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_percentage
FROM r
GROUP BY application_group
ORDER BY application_group
note: The denominator is every robot with a performance record in the group. MTBS is treated as not high risk when the stop count is 0 or the hours are null.

SELECT o.operrecref AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
       ROUND((3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval)::numeric, 2) AS throughput_cycles_per_hour
FROM operation o
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
WHERE o.cycletimesecval > 0 AND 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval < 180
ORDER BY 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval ASC
LIMIT 5
